visualCharacteristics: Boxed single-open accordion of OS releases (all collapsed initially); each panel groups driver entries under H3 category headings; each entry is a grey card with the driver name, Revision Number / File Size / Release Date label-value columns, an outlined Download button with a download icon, and a nested collapsible Driver Details area.
contentPattern: One item per OS: summary = OS label, text = rich text. In the text, H3 = category, H4 = driver name, paragraphs starting with a bold label = metadata lines (value may be empty), a paragraph containing only a link = Download button, all content after that link up to the next H3/H4 = Driver Details (description + release-notes links). Bodies without an H4 render as authored.

rows: Text: H3 category / H4 driver / bold-label meta paragraphs / lone Download link / details

usage.description: Per-OS driver download listing on product driver pages; single-open accordion with driver cards and nested Driver Details toggles.

reuseGuidance: Use for driver/software download lists grouped by OS. For plain FAQ-style expand/collapse use the base accordion; for spec tables use accordion-specs. The Driver Details toggle label can be overridden with the placeholder key "driver-details".
